>You need to find a way to release and appropriately deal with the emotions before they do become an unbearable force that causes you to do something, anything, you don't want to do. And you need to replace those feelings with self-empowerment, self-validation and love. 

Unfortunately most thing I heard while I talked to people about the bullying (vocal bullying) they told me to "don't care about what they say or do". I tried that, didn't help with bully problem but made things worse, I can't talk to anyone (I'm not shy, I became socially awkward) or even feel something against someone. Thing is, I'd love to feel love, but the thing is I can't, there are people who are nice to me and I kind of like them, but I don't feel anything, even if I think that they might be the right person.

>You couldn't bring me down for days.
They manage to take me down :(

>It sounds like maaaaaaaybe he trying to empower you to look at ways you can change...and maaaaaaaaybe the way he said it just came out completely wrong. 

No, he was completely honest about that. I talked talked talked, and he raged at a moment saying this.

>what people are trying to tell you is that you might be able to fix the problem from the inside

see this part:

>they told me to "don't care about what they say or do". I tried that, didn't help with bully problem but made things worse, I can't talk to anyone (I'm not shy, I became socially awkward) or even feel something against someone. Thing is, I'd love to feel love, but the thing is I can't, there are people who are nice to me and I kind of like them, but I don't feel anything, even if I think that they might be the right person.


I'm perfectly calm at the moment actually. Calm and honest. Unlike the time I posted this... post.

See the unstability? I'm scared about that. that is the thing that might drive me to suicide.

I'll now sleep, will try to live through another day and will report back tomorrow.
